scope: Edit an entire imported SPU ADPCM sample while retaining its length, tuning and loop metadata.

behavior.source: Decode all validated ADPCM packets with signed-short wrapping and continuous predictor history. No truncation to the 112-point preview, resampling, normalization or inferred period.
behavior.ui: The same PCM canvas supports full overview, min/max transient display, frame-range zoom, numeric index/value and drag-release edits. Source PCM stays outside periodic state messages.
behavior.preparation: Use a cancellable preparation Worker to re-encode full PCM. Applying stops held notes. Cancellation and stale source/view/owner changes cannot commit old work.
behavior.storage: Keep immutable original bank bytes and RAM. Use one reusable private full-size slot for equal-size edits. Preserve source frame count, loop flag/start, base frequency, all 24 preset PITCH/ADSR/vol/send values and shared effect settings.
behavior.capacity: The first private copy needs free SPU RAM. Main preflight rejects known insufficient capacity before encoding; the processor independently validates token, complete length, loop and capacity before ending Code or stopping voices.
behavior.ownership: Source tokens include assignment revision and byte identity, survive Code/temporary-audition checkpoint restoration, and refresh on every edit. Mutable copies are excluded from immutable ADPCM lookup.
behavior.morph: Full imported samples disable the 112-sample Morph enable control with an explanation. Choosing a shape explicitly returns to the separate short-cycle/Morph editor.
behavior.persistence: Existing version-1 instrument JSON stores edited ADPCM and unchanged tuning/loop data; no new preset schema or host-PCM substitution.
behavior.pausedPsf: Full-sample edits in paused Synth view keep the source position, frozen frame and original CH state. CH view stays read-only. Resume retains the edited author instrument.

limitations: Full-sample Morph, changing sample length/loop positions and editing Software audio host-memory recordings are outside this change.
PSF/Code Live display remains a bounded read-only observation; full editing is for the authored instrument.
